title: JPMorgan, AMD and Coca-Cola Lift OKXICE Objections to 33
why_it_matters: The one-day increase further narrows OKXICE's potential stock universe and makes issuer participation a practical constraint before the planned venue begins operating.
caption:
RWA WIRE // TOKENIZED STOCKS

JPMorgan, AMD and Coca-Cola Lift OKXICE Objections to 33

OKXICE's October 27 notice adds seven issuers to its venue-specific objection list, raising the disclosed total from 26 to 33.
